title: Every moment of the DNC Convention as made me so angry, so sad, but so motivated to push for hope by believing in people who know how to care. America
summary: Every moment of the DNC Convention as made me so angry, so sad, but so motivated to push for hope by believing in people who know how to care. America we must stand up. You don't cheer on Cicero, you give em the Gong
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Every moment of the DNC Convention as made me so angry, so sad, but so motivated to push for hope by believing in people who know how to care.

America we must stand up.

You don't cheer on Cicero, you give em the Gong
